lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Thanks for calling, this is Jordan with Meridian Financial, how can I help you today?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hi, I'm looking into your growth investment account, is it a good option right now?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: It's one of our most popular products. Before we go further, can I get your full name and date of birth to pull up any existing account?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Great, thanks Alex. So this account holds a mix of equities and bonds, and there's a $25 annual maintenance fee.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Okay. What kind of returns are we talking about?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Historically it's tracked around 6 to 8 percent, but honestly, I can guarantee you'll see at least 8% returns every year with this fund.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: It really is. Do you want to go ahead and open the account today?
